The core innovation lies in the triadic pipeline: select → rewrite → rerank. The selector uses RoBERTa to identify salient commentary segments within a sliding window, ensuring temporal coherence. The pseudo-labeler enhances this by combining BERTScore and ROUGE metrics to assign semantic relevance scores to candidate sentences. Finally, the reranker balances informativeness, fluency, and redundancy using learned weights. This structure allows GSE to process live commentary streams into structured narratives while maintaining fidelity to source events. The failure mode arises when either the selector misses key moments or the reranker misweights criteria, leading to loss of narrative clarity or redundancy.
